description: Verifies the implicit Gauss-Legendre integrators: exact straight-line propagation in flat spacetime with the fourth-order scheme, and conservation of the normalization, energy and angular momentum of a circular Schwarzschild orbit over 2000 steps with the sixth-order scheme.

checks.label: all one hundred implicit steps converge
the x coordinate advances by u^x times the proper time
the y coordinate advances by u^y times the proper time
the z coordinate advances by u^z times the proper time
all two thousand implicit steps converge
the four-velocity normalization drifts by less than 1e-11
the conserved energy drifts by less than 1e-11
the conserved angular momentum drifts by less than 1e-11
